newsitem.title: UK: UK promises to sign up for EU Social Chapter.
newsitem.headline: UK promises to sign up for EU Social Chapter.

text.p: Britain's new Labour government said on Wednesday it would strive to complete the European Union single market and sign up for the Social Chapter.

"In the European Union, my government will take a leading role. They will seek to promote employment, improve competitiveness, complete the Single Market and opt into the Social Chapter," Queen Elizabeth said in a speech written by cabinet ministers.
The Queen delivered the speech to formally open the new session of parliament following Labour's crushing victory in May 1 elections.
A government note accompanying the Queen's speech said to date, the Social Chapter only boasted two directives -- on parental leave and consultation rights for employees of multinational companies.
"Should any further legislative proposals be made, the government would make sure that the issues of employability and competitiveness were central to the decision-making process," it said.

The note said completion of the Single Market would open all areas of Europe to British business and the government supported European Commission plans to finish the process at the Amsterdam summit in June.

"The objective is a genuine Single Market, free of the distortions of hidden barriers and unfair state aid, particularly in areas where Britain is strong, like aviation, telecommunications, energy and financial services," the note said.
It said the government is setting up an inter-departmental taskforce on competitiveness in Europe, chaired by Sir David Simon, Minister for Trade and Competitiveness in Europe.
